The newest diagram or resume card opens it by itself; a newer one updates it in place. Closes on X, Esc, backdrop and the phone's back gesture (one history entry with the next __TSR_index). The chat keeps a thumbnail that opens it again. - FitView: a diagram fits the modal's width and height from its viewBox, aspect kept; the resume page fits the width (880 px cap on a desk) and scrolls. Zoom buttons, pinch, ctrl/cmd + wheel; Fit resets. Highlights use non-scaling-stroke. A wide diagram on an upright phone says to turn it or zoom. - The voice controls ride in the modal (ModalVoiceBar): the modal makes the page inert, so the sheet's and dock's Stop would be dead under it. - The resume: page image plus Download PDF (download attribute, never a new tab: a phone ends the conversation when the page is hidden). "See the resume" on the page is the hands path (ADR 0035). - LiveClient.continueTurn: a later conversation on the same page sends CONTINUE_TURN with the visitor's last question instead of the opener, so Alfred does not greet twice. - e2e/modals-shots.spec.ts: shots at 390 x 844 and 1440 x 900, with checks. 11e3aa69 · 4 files
forget_memory deleted every older version in the chain, so a member forgetting a shared fact could hard-delete an older version private to someone else. Lexical recall with durable (0.999/h) and episodic (0.99/h) decay. A deterministic filter keeps vault identifiers out of memory at every door. Tools: recall_memory, list_memories, remember, forget_memory on /mcp and the web assistant; recruiters excluded; the web prompt says it remembers. This amends engine-mcp ticket 06's memory exclusion for v2 by Kevin's ruling; the legacy tables stay out of the record tools. Worker fence: each heartbeat binds its device token to the Claude machine; memory refuses a listed machine's token and an unbound claude-session token. Consolidation: manage.py consolidate_memories reads finished conversation records (the person's words, tool-free replies only, never a read-through turn), asks the household's model for at most five items, supersedes contradicted facts. Crontab line added, not installed. ID vault (ADR 0076): public.vault_items sealed under LEGION_VAULT_KEY and public.vault_reveals; list/create/update never answer with a value; reveal and delete need a device token, reveal the phone's fingerprint header, 10 an hour, audited without the value. 3abcef4b · 3 files
"Any new mail today?" was answered "none" while mail had come in. The ask_mail router was handed no date, so "today" had nothing to anchor an after: to, and "new" could fall to the blank-query briefing (unread, Primary only), which hides mail already opened elsewhere or filed under Updates. GmailToolLogic.routeDateClause appends the clock (UTC offset, never a zone id) and today's and yesterday's local midnights in epoch seconds, because the Gmail API reads after:YYYY/MM/DD as Pacific midnight. It says new mail is recent mail, opened or not, and keeps is:unread for when the user says unread. Router system instruction only; no Live setup cost. The A25's manual DND rule had enabler=com.kevin.legion. dumpsys audio shows Quiet off restoring a SILENT ringer (setRingerMode external to 0, caller com.kevin.legion); Android's ringer delegate turns manual DND on for the caller, and it outlives Quiet's rule. Conversation-records ticket 03. Every LIVE_AUDIT, LIVE_LATENCY, LIVE_FOLLOWUP and LIVE_TOOL_CANCEL line is also appended, logcat threadtime-shaped, to a bounded spool under files/conversationlog/ (4 MB cap, 512 KB batches, oldest dropped first) on one writer thread. Sealed batches go to the engine's POST /api/device-logs/ as multipart (EngineHttp.postMultipart) with reason=conversation at session end, every 3 minutes while a session is live, and at app start. A batch is deleted only on a 2xx; anything else keeps it with backoff; an engine without the conversation reason is said once; no engine configured sends nothing and says so once. LiveAudit now runs when either the new keep-and-send setting (default on) or the logcat mirror is on, and its sink routes to each. Tests: spool bounds and order, window times, request fields and gzip round-trip on the wire, the retry table, settings-off writes nothing, byte-identity with LiveAudit's lines, and a spooled batch rendered by tools/voice_audit.py.
